partner_result.applied_to: global-mode identity for the exact finite and Gaussian-completion separated symmetric-unimodal three-bank families

new_result.headline: For a finite normalized positive-direction collinear heavy bank with max leverage square <=4/9, the Gaussian-completion central peak is <3sqrt(2) for arbitrary cap-one heavy laws; for centered interval laws the partner theorem upgrades this to the global peak, and exact finite source-valid bank matrices converge uniformly in density to that limit.
new_result.key_inequality: E exp[-c(sum a_i V_i)^2] <= (1+2c)^(-1/2) for c>=1/2, V_i~Unif[-sqrt(3),sqrt(3)]
new_result.mechanism: Fourier inversion + Holder exponents q_i=K/a_i^2 + Koenig-Koldobsky sinc inequality, then K0 positive-mixture integration
new_result.scope_limit: positive-direction collinear heavy bank; leverage-square threshold 4/9; arbitrary cap-one laws only central in the Gaussian-completion model; global finite statement uses centered intervals/symmetric-unimodality

unpaid_implication: No universal sharpness of 3sqrt(2) for arbitrary A. Remaining witness frontier includes unequal non-collinear shared-coordinate heavy rows, positive collinear leverage above 4/9 outside solved special cases, coupled spectral tails, finite/mesoscopic non-Gaussian residuals, and asymmetric/fragmented off-zero mechanisms.
next_step: Attack the remaining positive-collinear leverage window above 4/9 using a one-heavy-plus-residual K0 inequality, or move to unequal non-collinear two-heavy rows if that window stalls.
